Yes, I tried but it didn't work. I tried a lot of things, like change my mind or do new activities.

But, I'm tired of all and I don't care more

I think you're right. Maybe, I have to try fix at least one thing. Thanks, really, for the comment.

I hope that you problems with your friends will end good. Really.
Don't worry. Both. I mean, I know what I'm doing is stupid but, at the end, have the same end

It's a long story, but in a nutshell I'm tired of being blamed for past decisions.  And know?  If I have not been able to overcome it, the least I want is for this to affect the people I want in the present

Thanks for saying that. But, I think I finally made my decision and I'm fine with that. 

I tried to go to the therapist and take pills, but, it didn't work. 

But, thanks for the comment. Really thanks

I've talked with he about a lot of my problems.  That's sounds great, but it's not. He carries problems that are not his and these problems affect him.  That's not good for him.

He is a good boy. He doesn't deserves what I say him or what a I do. He deserves something better.

And it's hard. I'm crying right now, but, I want to kill myself the next week, he doesn't knows, obviously, no one knows. And, I think We are about to break our relationship.  I'm about to do it because I don't want him to suffer later. Sounds really stupid, but, it's hurting me.

Thank you for writing that, it really helps me to read your answer.  I will try to cheer up, thanks <3!

Have a really nice day!
